title: 寒暄与聊天气
goal: 能和邻居、同事简单寒暄，聊天气，并让对话自然地继续或结束。
tips: How's it going? / How are you doing? / What's up? 都是“最近怎么样”，回答 Not bad. / Pretty good. 就行，不用说太多。
天气是最安全的话题：It's a nice day, isn't it? 后面的 isn't it 是在找你认同，回答 Yes, it is. 就好。
想结束聊天：Well, I'd better get going. / Nice talking to you.

exchanges.reply: Pretty good, thanks. How about you?
Yes, it's beautiful. Finally some sun!
exchanges.replyZh: 是啊，真好，终于出太阳了！

exchanges.hear: Is it going to rain today?
exchanges.reply: The forecast says it will rain this afternoon.
I know. I'm wearing two sweaters.

exchanges.hear: What's the weather like in your hometown?
exchanges.reply: It's hot and humid in summer, and cold in winter.
exchanges.replyZh: 夏天又热又潮，冬天很冷。

exchanges.hear: Did you get caught in the rain?
Long time no see! What have you been up to?
exchanges.hearZh: 好久不见！最近在忙什么？
exchanges.reply: Not much. Just busy with work.
OK, nice talking to you. Have a good one!
exchanges.replyZh: 好的，聊得很开心。祝你愉快！

lines.en: Pretty good. It's really cold today, isn't it?
lines.zh: 挺好的。今天真冷啊，是吧？

lines.en: Yes, it's freezing. I think it's going to snow.
lines.zh: 是啊，冷死了。我觉得要下雪了。

lines.en: The forecast says snow tonight. Do you have an umbrella?
lines.zh: 天气预报说今晚有雪。你带伞了吗？

lines.en: Yes, it's in my bag. Are you going to work?
lines.zh: 带了，在包里。你去上班吗？

lines.en: Yes, I'm taking the bus today. Too cold to ride my bike.
lines.zh: 是的，今天坐公交，太冷了骑不了车。

lines.en: Good idea. Well, this is my floor. Have a good day!
lines.zh: 好主意。我到了，祝你今天愉快！
